第24章 坐镇CBD，核心就位-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

沈蔓的消息是早上七点发来的。

「今天下午飞曼谷，后天回。姐妹局等我回来再约，我跟她们说好了。」

后面跟了一个小小的亲吻表情。

林川单手打字：「注意安全！」

三秒后回了一条：「知道啦，婆婆妈妈的。」

林川笑了一下，把手机扣在桌上。

八点半，叶知秋的电话准时打进来。

“老板，办公场地我筛了四个，最终推荐一个。福田CBD，卓越世纪中心35楼，整层600平。”

“什么价？”

“年租三十万，含物业。”

林川靠在沙发上，手指在膝盖上敲了两下。

2000年的深圳，福田CBD黄金地段，35层整层，一年三十万。放在二十年后，这个价格连个厕所都租不下来。

“去看。”

“车已经在楼下了。”

林川换了一件黑色pOlO衫，下楼的时候，那辆黑色奥迪A6已经安安静静地停在门口。

叶知秋站在车门旁边，手里夹着一个深棕色的文件夹，头发扎得一丝不苟，早晨的阳光把她的侧脸照得很清晰。

上车之后，她没有急着发动，而是先翻开文件夹。

“办公场地之外，还有一件事先跟您汇报。”

“说。”

“招聘启事放出去两天了。投资经理、法务负责人、运营管理三个核心岗位，简历收了六十多份。”

林川挑了一下眉毛。

“其中有效简历四十二份，大部分是冲着薪资来的，但也有几个人——”叶知秋顿了一下，语气微微加重，“是冲着平台来的。”

“筛出来了？”

“筛了三个。履历最硬，意愿最强，而且——都能今天面。”

林川看了她一眼。

两天之内，看场地、收简历、筛人、约面试，四件事同步推。这个女人的执行力已经不是“特别助理”能概括的了。

“走吧。先看地方。”

车子驶出华侨城，沿着滨海大道转入深南大道，一路向东。

二十分钟后，黑色奥迪停在卓越世纪中心的地下车库。

电梯直达35层。

门一开，叶知秋在前面领路，林川跟在后面，踩着尚未铺设任何装饰的水泥地面走进去。

整层是空的。

600平的空间被几根承重柱分隔成自然的功能区块，南北通透，采光极好。

但真正让林川停下脚步的，是正对面那面从天花板延伸到地面的巨幅落地窗。

整个深圳的城市天际线——从莲花山到市民中心，从会展中心到远处隐约可见的深圳湾大桥——像一幅被摊开的长卷，毫无保留地铺在眼前。

2000年的深圳还没有后来那些密密麻麻的摩天大楼，天际线低矮而辽阔，到处都是工地的塔吊和正在拔地而起的钢筋骨架。

一座城市最值钱的时刻，就是它还没长成之前。

“三十万一年。”林川自言自语了一句，语气里带着一丝几乎不加掩饰的感慨。

叶知秋站在他身后三步远的位置，安静地等着。

“这个价格，二十年后大概只够在这栋楼下面租个早餐摊位。”

叶知秋没接话。她不确定老板是在感慨还是在跟她说话。

林川转过身来。

“租了。签一年，留续租优先权。装修你来盯，预算不限，简洁、大气、不花哨。一个大会议室，三个小会议室，独立办公室留五间，其余做开放工位。”

“两周之内能用吗？”

叶知秋翻了一下文件夹里夹着的一张施工报价单。

“如果今天签约，最快十二个工作日。”

“那就十二天。”

叶知秋合上文件夹，点了一下头。

“面试安排在哪儿？”

“这栋楼18层有一个共享办公空间，我提前租了一间会议室，四个小时。”

林川看了她一眼。什么都安排好了，连临时面试场地都提前订了。

十八层的共享会议室不大，一张长桌，六把椅子，墙上挂着一块白板。叶知秋提前放了矿泉水和几份打印好的简历在桌上。

Shen Man's message was sent at seven o'clock in the morning.

"I will fly to Bangkok this afternoon and come back the day after tomorrow. I will make an appointment with the sister bureau when I come back. I have made an agreement with them."

Followed by a small kissing emoji.

Lin Chuan typed with one hand: "Pay attention to safety!"

Three seconds later he replied: "I know, it's from my mother-in-law."

Lin Chuan smiled and put the phone on the table.

At half past eight, Ye Zhiqiu's call came in on time.

"Boss, I have screened four office spaces and finally recommended one. Futian CBD, 35th floor of Excellence Century Center, with an entire floor of 600 square meters."

"What price?"

"The annual rent is three hundred thousand, including property."

Lin Chuan leaned on the sofa and tapped his knees twice with his fingers.

In Shenzhen in 2000, the prime location of Futian CBD, with 35 floors, cost 300,000 yuan a year.Twenty years later, the price will not even allow you to rent a toilet.

"Go and see."

"The car is already downstairs."

Lin Chuan changed into a black pOlO shirt, and when he went downstairs, the black Audi A6 was already parked quietly at the door.

Ye Zhiqiu stood next to the car door, holding a dark brown folder in her hand, her hair tied up meticulously, and the morning sunlight illuminated her side face clearly.

After getting in the car, she didn't rush to start it, but opened the folder first.

"Besides the office space, I have one more thing to report to you in advance."

"Say."

"The recruitment notice has been out for two days. For the three core positions of investment manager, legal person in charge, and operations management, more than 60 resumes have been received."

Lin Chuan raised his eyebrows.

"There are forty-two valid resumes, most of them are here for salary, but there are also a few people -" Ye Zhiqiu paused, and his tone became slightly heavier, "They are here for the platform."

"Sifted out?"

"We screened three of them. The one with the strongest resume, the strongest willingness, and - all of them can be interviewed today."

Lin Chuan glanced at her.

Within two days, the four things were done at the same time: viewing the venue, collecting resumes, screening people, and scheduling interviews.This woman's execution ability cannot be summed up by "special assistant".

"Let's go. Look at the place first."

The car drove out of OCT, turned into Shennan Avenue along Binhai Avenue, and headed east.

Twenty minutes later, the black Audi parked in the underground garage of the Century Center of Excellence.

The elevator goes directly to the 35th floor.

As soon as the door opened, Ye Zhiqiu led the way, and Lin Chuan followed behind, walking in on the cement floor that had not been decorated with any decorations.

The entire floor is empty.

The 600-square-meter space is divided into natural functional areas by several load-bearing columns. It is transparent from north to south and has excellent lighting.

But what really stopped Lin Chuan was the huge floor-to-ceiling window directly opposite that stretched from the ceiling to the ground.

The entire city skyline of Shenzhen—from Lotus Mountain to the Civic Center, from the Convention and Exhibition Center to the Shenzhen Bay Bridge looming in the distance—is like a long scroll, spread out before your eyes without reservation.

In 2000, Shenzhen did not have the dense skyscrapers that it would later have. The skyline was low and vast, and there were tower cranes on construction sites and steel frames rising from the ground everywhere.

The most valuable moment for a city is before it has grown.

"Three hundred thousand a year." Lin Chuan muttered to himself, with a hint of barely concealed emotion in his tone.

Ye Zhiqiu stood three steps behind him, waiting quietly.

"This price will probably only be enough to rent a breakfast stall under this building in twenty years."

Ye Zhiqiu didn't answer.She wasn't sure if her boss was lamenting or talking to her.

Lin Chuan turned around.

"Rent. Sign for one year and have priority for renewal. You are responsible for the decoration. There is no budget limit. It is simple, elegant and not fancy. There is one large conference room, three small conference rooms, five independent offices, and the rest are open workstations."

"Can it be used within two weeks?"

Ye Zhiqiu flipped through a construction quotation in the folder.

"If we sign the contract today, it will be within twelve working days at the earliest."

"Then twelve days."

Ye Zhiqiu closed the folder and nodded.

"Where are the interviews scheduled?"

"There is a shared office space on the 18th floor of this building. I rented a conference room in advance for four hours."

Lin Chuan glanced at her.Everything has been arranged, even the temporary interview venue has been booked in advance.

The shared conference room on the 18th floor is not big, with a long table, six chairs, and a whiteboard hanging on the wall.Ye Zhiqiu put mineral water and several printed resumes on the table in advance.
